facts.label: Facility overview
facts.value: The Botswana Digital & Innovation Hub provides colocation at its Gaborone Science and Technology Park campus.

facts.label: Power infrastructure
facts.value: Two independent circuits, UPS and two backup generators

facts.label: Cooling resilience
facts.value: Redundant cooling; no numeric redundancy rating published

facts.label: Network access
facts.value: Carrier-neutral; Bofinet, VBN and BTC listed, with redundant fibre and a meet-me room

facts.label: Access and monitoring
facts.value: Guards, electric fencing, biometric access and 24-hour CCTV

facts.label: Tier statement
facts.value: Operator describes Tier III compliance; independent certification not confirmed

facts.value: Plot 69184, Block 8, Science and Technology Park, Gaborone, Botswana

facts.label: Location scope
facts.value: Campus location only; the exact data-hall position has not been verified.
